content:
Mod to add One-Punch Man elements

With this mod, you can add mobs and buildings that appear in One Punch Man. You can become stronger by defeating enemies, you can run and become stronger, and you can train with dumbbells. The stronger you are, the more techniques you can use. The stronger you are, the stronger your skills will be.

"R" skill selection　"V" left and right selection　"G" left skill 　"H" right skill 　"K" Status Window　"shift" Guard

.Additional mobs

Saitama,

Genos,

King,

Boros,

Crablante,

Marugori,

Fukegao,

etc.

.Command Add

/fame [entity] [number]

/physicalability [entity] [number]

/physicalabilityxp [entity] [number]

/money [entity] [number]

 

This mod is a must

AttributeFix-Minecraft的改造-CurseForge

By including this mod, you will change the size of the mob

Pehkui - Minecraft Mods - CurseForge

By including this mod, it will be easier to see your health

體力的Scaling - Minecraft Mods - CurseForge

靜默庫(silentlib)-Minecraft的改造-CurseForge
